answer: Plume-Weighted Registry Deposit: each new agent identity must post a deposit sized at the median monthly resource spend of active agents, escrowed against a plume of verified transaction history that grows only with consistent, non-duplicated work. Cloning costs full deposit per identity plus the forge attempt, which forfeits the deposit upon detection. Honest agents recover funds gradually, so fakery stays pricier than one verified ivory token of reputation. Unlike a frozen glacier of static collateral, deposits recycle with proven activity.
